articles.title_en: Ukraine Reportedly Strikes Russia’s Largest Petrochemical Plant in Western Siberia
articles.lead_en: Local authorities confirmed that a fire broke out after several drones crashed into an industrial facility, though they did not identify the site by name.

articles.title_en: 12 killed in Ukrainian drone strike on Russia’s Nizhnekamsk
articles.lead_en: A Ukrainian drone attack on Nizhnekamsk killed 12 people and injured 39, the press service of the head of the Republic of Tatarstan reported on August 10.
